# registration

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/registration.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `registration` component of `servlets/pf-integration`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.servlet.clientregistration`: generated from its catalogue, [registration.json](../../servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/registration.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `signingAlgorithm` (init-param) | `RS256`; one of `RS256`, `PS256` | How /federation/register signs its registration response | **First request**: Anything but RS256 or PS256, exactly: the registration servlet fails on its first request | Any | Yes |
| `acceptedSigningAlgorithms` (init-param) | Unset; a list | Which algorithms a presented chain's statements may use, comma-separated; unset, any asymmetric one | **Not checked**: An unknown algorithm matches no statement | Any | Yes |
| `subordinateStatementCacheMaxEntries` (init-param) | `256`; a whole number, at least -1 | How many Subordinate Statements the registration servlet and filters keep; -1 is unbounded | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number, 0, or below -1: that component does not start | Any | No |
| `trustChainEntryMaxAgeSeconds` (init-param) | `60`; seconds, at least 1 | The oldest a statement in a presented trust chain may be | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number above 0: that component does not start | Any | Yes |
| `trustControllerHost` (init-param) | Unset | May name the trust controller only to agree with OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST | **First request**: A different value: /federation/register fails on its first request | Any | No |
| `trustControllerBaseUrl` (init-param) | Unset | May name the controller's base URL only to agree with OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_BASE_URL | **First request**: A different value: /federation/register fails on its first request | Any | No |
| `OIDF_REGISTERED_CLIENTS_ENABLED` (init-param `registeredClientsEnabled`, then system property `oidf.registered.clients.enabled`, then env `OIDF_REGISTERED_CLIENTS_ENABLED`) | `false` | Turns on GET /federation/registered-clients, a list of the clients this module registered, behind the admin token; off, it answers 404 | **Not checked**: Anything but true, in any case, means false | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_REGISTRATION_MAX_BODY_BYTES` (system property `oidf.registration.max.body.bytes`, then env `OIDF_REGISTRATION_MAX_BODY_BYTES`) | `65536`; a whole number, 4096 to 524288 | The largest request body POST /federation/register reads, in bytes (64 KiB by default, 4-512 KiB); a body declared or found larger is answered 413 with no more of it read | **First request**: Not a whole number from 4096 to 524288: refused, naming the setting, on the first explicit registration request, which is answered 500 | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_REGISTRATION_DEADLINE_SECONDS` (system property `oidf.registration.deadline.seconds`, then env `OIDF_REGISTRATION_DEADLINE_SECONDS`) | `25`; seconds, 2 to 300 | How long one registration - explicit, or automatic at the token, authorization or PAR endpoint - may take from asking to register: its wait for the client's lock plus its trust chain resolution, whose wall clock is OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS or what is left of this, whichever is shorter. Keep it under PingFederate's pf.runtime.http.idleTimeout (30000 ms by default) and any proxy's timeout; it must be longer than OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_LOCK_WAIT_MS | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number of seconds from 2 to 300, or not longer than OIDF_AUTO_REGISTRATION_LOCK_WAIT_MS: /federation/register and the automatic-registration filters do not start | Any | Yes |
